_comment: Runeblade hero. Second ability ('whenever you play a Shadow non-attack action card, you may pay {h}; the next Runechant effect that would deal damage this turn can't be prevented') is not modeled — needs unpreventable-damage tracking.

abilities._comment: At the start of your turn, banish a card from your hand. If you do, create a Runechant token. (The 'if you do' guard on empty hand is not modeled; BANISH no-ops on an empty hand.)
